query:
UPDATE api_tokens
            SET
                last_used_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_used_at, $3), $3),
                last_used_ip = CASE
                    WHEN last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at < $3 THEN $4
                    ELSE last_used_ip
                END
            WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND revoked_at IS NULL
